Design.evidence_source: Participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: Dictator – Ruler – Hidden (DRH) or Dictator – Ruler (DR).

country.evidence_source: We conducted an experiment in the BonnEconLab at the University of Bonn, Germany.

info_cost.evidence_source: The dictator could reveal the recipient’s payoff from option A and option B at no cost.

extract_value.key: Dictator – Ruler – Hidden vs Dictator – Ruler

Sample.evidence_source: In the DRH condition, 15 out of 60 dictators chose option A. In the DR condition, 5 out of 60 dictators chose option A.
